channel.title: Daily Science Intake
channel.description: We will include a daily research summary — from an AI creator — to listen to whenever, and use it as a way to increase our exposure to science! In a nutshell, lazy people's way of reading papers.
channel.itunes:author: Paz Nativ

item.title: Turning Hollow Spheres Into Electrochemical Microreactors for Uranium Extraction
item.description: We explore a groundbreaking uranium extraction technology that reimagines hollow carbon spheres as confined electrochemical microreactors. By combining electric-field-driven ion transport, spatial confinement, and in-situ reduction, researchers achieved an 8-fold capacity increase over conventional adsorption—pointing toward a new paradigm in resource recovery where nanoarchitecture and electrochemistry work in synergy.
